analysis.title: The Funeral Of The Century Is Wall Street Burying The AI Trade
key_insights: Morgan Stanley's AI beneficiaries basket fell 16% in a week while the S&P 500 barely moved. The AI trade is cracking while the broader market holds up.
MS QDS data shows AI beneficiaries are down 25% from their highs relative to the rest of the market.
GS trading desk notes tech flows are still stretched, but buying is starting to reverse.
JPM PI shows global hedge fund positioning is still heavily skewed toward semiconductors.
High yield credit spreads have widened, especially for AI-related issuers. AI hyperscaler equities were 15% lower the last time spreads were this wide (iBoxx).
Morgan Stanley Prime recorded a three-standard-deviation selling event by hedge funds, with US long/short net exposure falling to 49%, near yearly lows. Positioning is already getting light.

GS Prime reports US Fundamental L/S net leverage fell 3.2 pts to 43.7%, the largest weekly decline since the week of Liberation Day (Apr '25) and the 4th largest in five years. This is the 0th percentile of the five-year range.
De-grossing among multi-strat hedge funds was among the strongest in the past couple of years, and alpha turned negative (JPM PI).
The VIX closed above its long-term average of 19.5 for the first time since late July (Koyfin).
The average 3-month implied volatility for Mag 7 stocks was near multi-year lows, so downside protection is not prohibitively expensive (GS vol desk).
Vanda's aggregate positioning indicator has gone nowhere since the summer, with hedge fund exposure rolling over and institutional options buying losing momentum.
